items.stem: A colleague asks for a one-line answer to a quick factual question. Why is a plain chat reply usually the better choice than an Artifact here?

options.text: An Artifact adds overhead and versioning that a single short answer does not need
options.rationale: Correct: Artifacts suit content that will be edited, reused or shared; a one-off answer does not.
Artifacts routinely contain text; that is not the distinction.

options.text: Chat replies are always more accurate
options.rationale: Accuracy does not depend on the surface used.
Artifacts support documents, pages and more, not only code.

items.explanation: Correct: Artifacts suit content that will be edited, reused or shared; a one-off answer does not.

items.stem: Which TWO are appropriate uses of an interactive Artifact prototype in professional work? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Demonstrating a proposed workflow to stakeholders for feedback
options.rationale: Correct: prototypes are well suited to eliciting feedback on an idea.

options.text: Deploying it directly as the company's production system
options.rationale: A prototype is illustrative, not production-hardened software.

options.text: Exploring a layout or calculation before committing to engineering
options.rationale: Correct: prototypes let teams test an approach cheaply first.

options.text: Storing the only copy of regulated customer records
options.rationale: An Artifact prototype is not a system of record for regulated data.

items.explanation: Correct: prototypes are well suited to eliciting feedback on an idea.

items.stem: Before sharing an Artifact externally, what should you check first?

options.text: Whether the Artifact contains confidential or internal-only data
options.rationale: Correct: sharing can expose embedded data, so review contents before release.

options.text: Whether the Artifact uses the newest colour theme
options.rationale: Visual theme is not a confidentiality control.

options.text: Whether the chat was longer than ten messages
options.rationale: Conversation length is irrelevant to sharing safety.

items.explanation: Correct: sharing can expose embedded data, so review contents before release.
